about: I'm Rhett, a news-focused multimedia journalist from the Omaha metro area, passionate about finding the human side of the headlines. From on-camera reporting to editing and producing, I believe the best journalism makes complex issues accessible and gives communities a voice.

stories.title: The cycle of tragedy: Experts explain how gaps in mental health care can lead to crisis after fatal incident at Walmart near UNO
stories.description: After a kidnapping which turned into a fatal shooting on a spring Tuesday morning at a Walmart Supermarket minutes away from UNO campus buildings, a single frame from the bodycam of the Omaha Police Officer who shot 31-year-old Noemi Guzman went viral on the internet. The image showed the officer pointing his handgun at Guzman, who was swinging a stolen kitchen knife at a three-year-old boy whom she was holding hostage in a shopping cart. Further investigation into the incident turned up evidence that long before Guzman ended up on the wrong end of a gun, she had years of experience cycling through state criminal justice and mental health support systems that proved themselves to be inept. In this investigative piece I wrote in my Junior year as a News Writer for The Gateway, the greater systemic issues surrounding Nebraska's mental health services and lack of support for patients and families is the subject of my scrutiny.

stories.title: How Jukes Ale Works Gives Back One Beer at a Time
stories.description: For a giving-themed issue of Omaha Magazine published in September of 2026, I visited a family-owned Elkhorn brewery to review not just the food and drinks, but also the impact that the establishment is making in the community through their engagement programs, fundraisers, donations and more.

stories.title: Songbirds and Scenic Views at Schramm Park - How Nebraska’s Oldest State Fish Hatchery Became a Hidden Gem
stories.description: For Edge Magazine's August 2026 issue, I took readers along for an exploration of Nebraska's oldest state fish hatchery at Schramm Park, combining coverage of the site's historical significance with information on how the park continues to evolve and attract new audiences.

stories.title: Omaha Streetcar Alliance Founder Steps Down, Closes Business Citing Disruptive Streetcar Construction
stories.description:
I reported on an escalation in the ongoing tensions between Omaha's downtown streetcar project, and the business owners who make up the Omaha Streetcar Impact Alliance: 
The Mercury Lounge is just one business that decided to close down citing disruptive construction for the Omaha Streetcar Project. But one thing is different. This business is owned by the Omaha Streetcar Impact Alliance Founder, and his departure is steeping the entire coalition in uncertainty.

stories.title: Local Taxpayers and Educators Raise Concerns as Omaha Public Schools Works Through State Aid Deduction With Property Tax Hikes and Changes to Teacher Pay
stories.description: When a state accounting error causes a major budget shortfall in Omaha's largest public school district, local taxpayers and educators are concerned about being left to foot the bill.

stories.title: Community in a Cone: How Elkhorn Residents are Keeping a Tasty Tradition Alive
stories.description: According to the Federal Bureau of Labor Statistics, fewer Americans are spending time socializing compared to a decade ago, but in Elkhorn, there is one ice cream shop preparing to close for the season, that has been bringing the neighborhood together for over 50 years.
